name: Philippine Regular ePassport
description: Primary international travel document and sovereign proof of Philippine citizenship issued to Filipino citizens.
processingTime: 12 working days (NCR Regular) / 6 working days (NCR Expedited)

whatToBring.item: Printed confirmed online appointment packet (form with barcodes and payment receipt)
Original Certificate of Live Birth issued by PSA on security paper (SECPA)
Clear photocopy of PSA Certificate of Live Birth
One valid government-issued photo ID (e.g., PhilID, UMID, Driver's License, Voter's Certification with dry seal)
Clear photocopy of valid government-issued photo ID
Original PSA Marriage Certificate on security paper (for married females adopting husband's surname)
Clear photocopy of PSA Marriage Certificate (for married females adopting husband's surname)

requirements: PSA Marriage Certificate (if married female adopting husband's surname)
Appropriate collared attire (no piercings, dangling earrings, or cosmetic contact lenses)

steps.instruction: Access passport.gov.ph, select a consular site, reserve an appointment slot, and complete the demographic questionnaire.
Settle the processing fee through designated payment channels within the mandated payment window.
Download and print the emailed appointment confirmation packet in standard A4 paper format.
Appear at the designated DFA Consular Office 15 to 30 minutes before your schedule in appropriate collared attire.
Present your appointment packet and original documents at the preliminary verification window for document authentication.
Complete biometric capture (digital portrait, 10-fingerprint scanning, and electronic signature).
Confirm encoded entries on the verification screen and submit the transaction slip to the courier desk or keep the claim stub.

name: NBI Multi-Purpose Clearance
description: Official criminal database certificate confirming whether an applicant has an active derogatory or criminal record in the Philippines.
fees: ₱130.00 statutory fee + ₱25.00 to ₱30.00 e-payment surcharge (₱0.00 for verified First-Time Jobseekers under RA 11261)
processingTime: 15 to 30 minutes onsite (No 'HIT'); 5 to 10 working days (With 'HIT')

whatToBring.item: Printed or digital copy of system-generated NBI Reference Number or QR code
Electronic payment receipt or transaction confirmation slip
Two original unexpired valid government-issued photo IDs bearing signature
Original Barangay Certificate affirming First-Time Jobseeker status under RA 11261 (if applicable)
Signed Oath of Undertaking for First-Time Jobseekers (if applicable)

requirements: Proper dress code for biometric photograph

steps.instruction: Access clearance.nbi.gov.ph (or firsttimejobseekers.nbi.gov.ph) and register an account.
Complete the Applicant Information Form with personal, family, and educational details, then save.
Click 'Apply for Clearance', select the government ID you will present, and choose an appointment date, time, and branch.
Select your payment channel, settle the ₱130 fee plus service surcharge, and save your generated Reference Number.
Visit the scheduled NBI branch and present your Reference Number or QR code at document screening.
Complete biometric capture (photograph, rolled ten-fingerprint scan, and electronic signature).
Verify your demographic details on the monitor; proceed to printing if 'No HIT' or await the 5-10 day investigation window if with 'HIT'.

name: PhilSys National ID (PhilID / ePhilID)
description: Foundational identification document issued to all Filipino citizens and resident aliens under RA 11055.
whereToGo: PSA Fixed PhilSys Registration Center, LGU/Mall Site, or Mobile Registration Post
fees: ₱0.00 (Free of charge for initial registration and ePhilID issuance)
processingTime: 10 to 15 minutes onsite; physical PVC delivery subject to production transit
validity: Permanent / Lifetime (Recapture of biometrics required at ages 5 and 15)

whatToBring.item: Primary supporting document (Original PSA Birth Certificate + photo ID, DFA Passport, UMID, or Driver's License)
Secondary supporting document (if primary document is unavailable: Voter's ID/Cert, Postal ID, TIN ID, etc.)
PSA Certificate of Live Birth and parent's PhilSys Number (for minor applicants ages 1 to 4)

requirements: Original primary or secondary supporting identification document
Personal appearance of parent with PSN (for children ages 1 to 4)

steps.instruction: Proceed to an operating fixed PSA Registration Center, mall site, or active mobile registration post.
Present original primary or secondary identity documents to the Registration Kit Operator for authentication.
Undergo biometric data enrollment (dual iris scanning, 10-fingerprint impression, and neutral front portrait).
Verify the demographic data encoded on the customer-facing screen to confirm accuracy.
Receive the PhilSys Transaction Slip showing the 29-digit Transaction Reference Number (TRN) to track delivery or claim ePhilID.

name: Student-Driver's Permit
description: Official authority granted to a citizen allowing them to learn and operate a motor vehicle under the supervision of a licensed driver.
whereToGo: LTO Licensing Center or District Office
processingTime: Approximately 1 hour and 50 minutes (excluding initial queueing)
validity: 1 Year (Non-renewable for driving instruction after expiration)

whatToBring.item: Duly accomplished Application for Permits and Licenses (APL) form
Original PSA Certificate of Live Birth or valid DFA Philippine Passport
Clear photocopy of PSA Certificate of Live Birth or DFA Philippine Passport
Physical copy of Theoretical Driving Course (TDC) Certificate of Completion
Physical copy of electronically transmitted Medical Certificate from LTO-accredited clinic
One original valid government-issued photo ID of the applicant
Clear photocopy of valid government-issued photo ID
Written parental or guardian consent (for applicants aged 16 to 17)
Original and photocopy of parent or guardian's valid government photo ID (for applicants aged 16 to 17)

requirements: Minimum age of 16 for Filipinos (18 for foreigners)
Personal appearance for photo and signature capture

steps.instruction: Complete the mandatory 15-hour Theoretical Driving Course (TDC) via an accredited driving school or LTO DEC.
Undergo medical evaluation at an LTO-accredited clinic to ensure electronic transmission of your medical certificate.
Log into the LTMS portal, book a transaction schedule at your preferred LTO Licensing Center, and print the appointment slip.
Submit all physical requirements at the LTO Customer Service Assistant desk for preliminary verification and queue ticketing.
Proceed to the encoding window for live digital photo, signature capture, and fingerprint recording.
Pay the ₱250.00 statutory fees at the cashier counter.
Await application approval and claim the physical Student-Driver's Permit card or official electronic document receipt.

name: Non-Professional Driver's License
description: Official legal authority allowing a qualified motorist to operate light private passenger vehicles on public roads.
whereToGo: LTO Licensing Center or District Office
fees: ₱685.00 (₱100.00 Application Fee + ₱585.00 License Fee); Practical vehicle rental: ₱250.00 to ₱500.00 (if personal vehicle is not provided)
processingTime: 3 to 4 hours (including examinations and practical evaluation)
validity: 5 Years (Initial issuance); 10 Years (Upon renewal with zero demerit points)

whatToBring.item: Duly accomplished Application for Permits and Licenses (APL) form
Valid Student-Driver's Permit (held for a minimum of 30 days and within its 1-year validity)
Physical copy of Practical Driving Course (PDC) Certificate of Completion
Physical copy of electronically transmitted Medical Certificate from LTO-accredited clinic
Documentary proof of Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) (for employed applicants)
Parental consent document and original parent valid ID plus photocopy (for 17-year-old applicants)

requirements: Valid Student-Driver's Permit held for at least 30 days
Passing score on LTMS Theoretical Examination
Passing score on Practical Driving Test

steps.instruction: Complete Practical Driving Course (PDC) hours (minimum 8 hours) and verify digital transmission to LTO IT system.
Submit documentary requirements at the designated LTO Licensing Center evaluation desk.
Pay the ₱100.00 application fee at the cashier window.
Take and pass the computerized Theoretical Examination on road safety and driving rules on the LTMS terminal.
Take and pass the Practical Driving Test covering parking, vehicle maneuvering, and road driving.
Return to the cashier to pay the ₱585.00 license fee.
Proceed to the biometric counter for photo capture, signature recording, and issuance of the 5-year PVC driver's license card.

name: National Police Clearance
description: National security clearance verifying whether an applicant has an active derogatory criminal record or outstanding arrest warrant.
fees: ₱150.00 statutory fee + ₱30.00 electronic convenience charge (₱0.00 for verified First-Time Jobseekers under RA 11261)

whatToBring.item: Printed or digital NPCS appointment confirmation slip or reference barcode
Official payment confirmation receipt / electronic Official Receipt (eOR)
Two original unexpired government-issued IDs bearing photo and signature
Original Barangay Certificate affirming First-Time Jobseeker status under RA 11261 (if applicable)
Signed Oath of Undertaking for First-Time Jobseekers (if applicable)

steps.instruction: Register an account on pnpclearance.ph and complete your personal profile information.
Select your preferred police station, date, and appointment slot for in-person biometric capture.
Pay the ₱150 fee plus ₱30 convenience charge via LandBank Link.Biz portal (GCash, Maya, or partner merchants).
Report to the selected police station on your scheduled date and time with your appointment code and two original IDs.
Undergo biometric capture (live facial portrait, rolled 10-fingerprints, and electronic signature).
Wait for automated database matching; if clear of derogatory records, claim your printed and dry-sealed clearance certificate.

name: Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN)
description: Permanent 9-digit system index number assigned by the BIR for individual tax accounting and official regulatory transactions.
whereToGo: BIR Revenue District Office (RDO) with territorial jurisdiction
fees: ₱0.00 (TIN issuance and initial enrollment are strictly free of charge)
processingTime: 30 minutes to 1 working day upon reaching the evaluation counter

whatToBring.item: Two accomplished copies of BIR Form 1902 (for local employees) or Form 1904 (for EO 98 / first-time jobseekers)
One original valid government-issued photo ID showing legal name, birth date, and address
Clear photocopy of valid government-issued photo ID
PSA Certificate of Live Birth (if the presented government ID lacks full birth details)
Company Letter of Authority or HR endorsement confirming formal engagement (for Form 1902 applicants)
Original Barangay Certificate issued pursuant to RA 11261 (for first-time jobseekers under Form 1904)
Marriage Contract (for married female registrants, if applicable)

requirements: Two accomplished copies of BIR Form 1902 or Form 1904
Zero existing TIN records in the BIR Integrated Tax System

steps.instruction: Fill out BIR Form 1902 (through employer) or Form 1904, or encode details directly via BIR ORUS (orus.bir.gov.ph).
Obtain a queue ticket at the Client Support Section (CSS) of your designated Revenue District Office (RDO).
Submit the completed physical forms and supporting identity documents to the duty registration officer.
Wait while the officer executes an Integrated Tax System check to verify zero existing duplicate TIN records.
Receive the stamped receiving acknowledgment copy containing your permanent 9-digit system TIN and 3-digit branch code.

name: Social Security (SS) Number
description: Permanent lifetime identification number ensuring social insurance coverage against sickness, maternity, disability, retirement, and death.
whereToGo: Online Portal (In-person SSS Branch appearance only required if manual document validation is flagged)
fees: ₱0.00 (Issuance of an SS number is completely free)
processingTime: Immediate online issuance; 1 to 2 working days if supporting documents require branch evaluation

whatToBring.item: Printed system-generated SS Number slip
Original PSA-issued Certificate of Live Birth (or NSO copy with birth reference number)
Clear photocopy of PSA Certificate of Live Birth
One primary valid government-issued ID (Passport, UMID, Driver's License, or PhilID in the absence of a birth certificate)

requirements: Active personal email address and mobile contact number
Scanned PDF or JPEG copy of PSA Birth Certificate or primary ID

steps.instruction: Access sss.gov.ph, navigate to 'Apply for an SS Number Online', and accept the terms of service.
Input legal demographic details (full legal name, date of birth, mother's maiden name) and submit.
Open the validation link delivered to your personal email inbox and complete the full electronic registration form.
Upload a clear scanned PDF or JPEG copy of your PSA Birth Certificate or accepted primary government ID.
Download your generated SS Number, electronic SS Number slip, and account confirmation notice.
If document upload fails or status is tagged as temporary, visit an SSS branch with the printed slip and original birth certificate.

name: PhilHealth Identification Number (PIN) & MDR
description: Permanent healthcare membership number and Member Data Record (MDR) providing subsidized medical and health insurance coverage.
whereToGo: PhilHealth Local Health Insurance Office (LHIO) or Mall-based Service Center
fees: ₱0.00 (Registration, Member Data Record release, and paper ID issuance carry zero charges)

whatToBring.item: One original PhilHealth Member Registration Form (PMRF), fully accomplished and signed
One original valid photo-bearing government-issued ID
One clear photocopy of valid photo-bearing government-issued ID
Certificate of Employment or formal job contract (for formal direct employees)
Clear photocopy of PSA Marriage Certificate (if declaring legal spouse as dependent)
Clear photocopy of PSA Birth Certificates (if declaring minor children below 21 years old as dependents)

requirements: Supporting civil registry documents (if declaring legal dependents)

steps.instruction: Download and accomplish the PMRF, or complete initial enrollment via the eGovPH mobile super app.
Submit the completed PMRF and supporting ID proofs to the Public Assistance and Complaints Desk (PACD) at a PhilHealth LHIO.
Wait while the frontline evaluator reviews data completeness, encodes records, and verifies dependent qualifications.
Receive your system-generated PhilHealth Identification Number (PIN), printed Member Data Record (MDR), and laminated paper ID card.

name: Pag-IBIG Member Identification (MID) Number
agency: Home Development Mutual Fund (HDMF / Pag-IBIG Fund)
description: Mandatory 12-digit savings and shelter financing account number for housing loans and providential provident savings.
whereToGo: Virtual Pag-IBIG Portal (In-person branch visit optional for Loyalty Card Plus capture)
fees: ₱0.00 (Basic registration/MID); ₱125.00 card fee (Only if securing the optional Pag-IBIG Loyalty Card Plus)
processingTime: Immediate online RTN generation; 2 to 3 working days for conversion to a permanent MID

whatToBring.item: Printed system-generated online registration confirmation printout / Member Data Form (MDF)
One original valid government-issued photo ID (e.g., PhilID, Passport, Driver's License, SSS ID)
Clear photocopy of valid government-issued photo ID
Original PSA Birth Certificate or Marriage Certificate (if necessary to verify civil details or dependents)

requirements: Online demographic registration on Virtual Pag-IBIG
Active mobile number for SMS OTP authentication

steps.instruction: Access the Virtual Pag-IBIG portal (pagibigfundservices.com) and navigate to the 'Member Registration' module.
Enter your full name and birth date, verify via SMS security code, and fill out residential, employment, and familial details.
Submit the digital form to generate your temporary Registration Tracking Number (RTN) and summary sheet.
After 2 to 3 working days of deduplication, text your RTN to the official inquiry number or verify on Virtual Pag-IBIG to claim your MID.
(Optional) Visit any Pag-IBIG branch, present your MID, pay ₱125 to the partner bank kiosk, and capture biometrics for a Loyalty Card Plus.

name: PSA Civil Registry Certificates (Birth, Marriage, Death, CENOMAR)
description: Official certified civil registry records printed on security paper (SECPA) establishing baseline legal lineage, marital status, or civil facts.
fees: ₱155.00 per copy for Birth, Marriage, Death (₱125 fee + ₱30 DST); ₱210.00 per copy for CENOMAR (₱180 fee + ₱30 DST)
processingTime: 1 to 2 hours for onsite walk-in processing at CRS outlet; 3 to 7 working days for online courier delivery
validity: Permanent / Lifetime (SECPA does not expire, though receiving institutions typically mandate issuance within 6 months)

whatToBring.item: Printed PSA CRS Online Appointment slip with QR code
Duly accomplished CRS Application Form (Birth, Marriage, Death, or CENOMAR)
One original valid government-issued photo ID of the applicant
Clear photocopy of valid government-issued photo ID
Original signed authorization letter from the document owner (if applying through an authorized representative)
Original and photocopy of the document owner's valid government ID (if applying through representative)
Original and photocopy of the representative's valid government ID (if applying through representative)

requirements: Duly accomplished CRS application form with complete demographic details
Document owner eligibility or signed authorization letter

steps.instruction: Visit appointment.psa.gov.ph, select a CRS outlet, choose the civil document type, and book an appointment slot.
Arrive at the PSA CRS Outlet 15 minutes before your schedule and present your printed appointment QR slip.
Get a priority queue number, enter the screening zone, and submit your accomplished application form and valid IDs.
Proceed to the cashier counter and pay the statutory certification fee (₱155 or ₱210 per copy).
Wait in the document releasing area, then present your official receipt and valid ID to claim the SECPA certificate.

name: Voter's Certification
description: Official certification issued to registered voters verifying active registration, precinct assignment, and legal residency.
whereToGo: Local COMELEC Office of the Election Officer (OEO) in city/municipality of registration
fees: ₱0.00 (Statutory ₱75.00 fee officially suspended under COMELEC Minute Resolution No. 24-0114)
processingTime: 10 to 15 minutes per transaction at local OEO
validity: Typically 6 months to 1 year (as accepted by receiving institutions)

whatToBring.item: One original valid government-issued photo ID bearing signature (PhilSys ID, Driver's License, Postal ID, Student ID)
One clear photocopy of valid government-issued photo ID
Signed authorization letter or Special Power of Attorney (SPA) (if transacting through a representative)
Original and photocopy of the voter's valid ID and representative's valid ID (if transacting through representative)

requirements: Active registered voter record in the local municipality/district
One valid government-issued photo ID with signature

steps.instruction: Report to the local COMELEC Office of the Election Officer (OEO) where you are registered.
Log your name in the request registry and complete the Voter's Certification request slip.
Present your valid photo ID to the election assistant to verify active status and precinct record in the database.
Wait while the terminal operator formats and prints your official certification printout.
The Election Officer reviews the document, applies their official agency signature, and stamps the official dry seal.
Sign the acknowledgment release logbook and claim your stamped Voter's Certification.

name: Digitized Postal Identity Card
description: Secure, digitized biometric identification card issued to Filipino citizens and resident foreigners confirming physical identity and address.
whereToGo: Authorized Post Office or Mall-based Postal Capturing Site
fees: ₱550.00 (Inclusive of 12% VAT, biometric PVC fabrication, and door-to-door mail delivery)
processingTime: 10 to 15 working days (Metro Manila); 15 to 25 working days (Provincial)

whatToBring.item: Two copies of the duly accomplished Postal ID Application Form
Original Proof of Identity (PSA Birth Certificate, DFA Passport, Driver's License, or SSS/GSIS UMID)
Clear photocopy of Proof of Identity
Original Proof of Address (Barangay Certificate of Residency issued within 3 months, utility bill, or bank statement)
Clear photocopy of Proof of Address
Original and photocopy of PSA Marriage Certificate (for married females adopting husband's surname)

requirements: Personal appearance for digital portrait, fingerprints, and electronic signature

steps.instruction: Complete two copies of the application form and assemble your proof of identity and proof of address.
Submit documents to the capturing teller at an authorized post office or mall capturing booth.
Pay the ₱550 fee at the postal cashier window.
Undergo digital capture: live portrait photograph, dual-thumb biometric impression, and digital signature.
Verify encoded data on the operator's preview screen to confirm zero spelling errors.
Receive your transaction stub and await direct door-to-door delivery of the PVC card by your area mail carrier.

name: Certificate of Business Name Registration (Sole Proprietorship)
description: Legal certificate establishing the sole proprietor's authority to use a specific commercial name for business operations.
whereToGo: DTI BNRS Portal (Online) or DTI Negosyo Center
fees: ₱200 (Barangay Scope), ₱500 (City/Municipality Scope), ₱1,000 (Regional Scope), ₱2,000 (National Scope) + ₱30 Documentary Stamp Tax

whatToBring.item: Digital copy of one valid government-issued photo ID (uploaded during online registration)
Proposed Business Name (Dominant Name and PSIC Business Descriptor)

requirements: Filipino citizen at least 18 years of age
Active Philippine mobile number and email address

steps.instruction: Access bnrs.dti.gov.ph, click 'New Registration', and accept the terms of service agreement.
Input the owner's legal demographic data, residential address, and upload valid government ID details.
Select your territorial scope, enter your proposed dominant business name and descriptor, and run name evaluation.
Review the assigned Reference Code, verify entered enterprise details, and sign the electronic Undertaking.
Settle the prescribed registration fee and DST via GCash, Maya, LandBank Link.Biz, or credit/debit card within 7 days.
Download and print your Certificate of Business Name Registration sent to your registered email address.

name: Barangay Clearance & Certificate of Residency
description: Local administrative certification proving bona fide residency and clean standing within the community.
whereToGo: Local Barangay Hall having territorial jurisdiction
fees: ₱50.00 to ₱100.00 standard administrative fee (₱0.00 for verified First-Time Jobseekers under RA 11261)
processingTime: 10 to 20 minutes for counter walk-in processing
validity: 3 to 6 Months from date of issuance

whatToBring.item: Accomplished Barangay Clearance Request Slip
One valid government-issued ID or current Student ID
Clear photocopy of valid government ID or Student ID
Proof of address (utility bill, lease contract, or endorsement by Purok/Sitio Leader)
Current Community Tax Certificate (Cedula)
Signed Oath of Undertaking under RA 11261 (for entry-level first-time jobseekers)

requirements: Minimum residency in the barangay (typically 3 to 6 months)
Accomplished request slip with stated transaction purpose

steps.instruction: Proceed to the Barangay Hall where you reside and present your proof of residency and valid ID.
Request a Barangay Clearance or Certificate of Residency, stating your intended legal or employment purpose.
If applying as an entry-level worker, present your signed Oath of Undertaking to claim RA 11261 fee waiver.
Wait while the desk officer verifies records, checks blotter entries, and logs the request in the registry.
Pay the clearance fee at the barangay treasury counter (or claim exemption under RA 11261).
Secure the signature of the Punong Barangay or duty Kagawad, verify the dry seal, and claim your physical certificate.

name: Mayor's Permit and Barangay Business Clearance
description: Comprehensive local municipal license authorizing a commercial establishment to legally operate within city/municipal boundaries.
whereToGo: Business One-Stop Shop (BOSS) at City/Municipal Hall and Local Barangay Hall
fees: Variable based on declared capitalization, classification, and floor area (typically ₱1,500.00 to ₱10,000.00+)
processingTime: 1 to 3 working days via standard Business One-Stop Shop (BOSS) processing
validity: 1 Calendar Year (Expires December 31; renewal required January 1 to 20)

whatToBring.item: Duly accomplished Unified Business Permit Application Form
Original and photocopy of DTI Certificate of Business Name Registration (or SEC Articles of Incorporation)
Original Barangay Business Clearance issued by the local barangay where the enterprise is located
Proof of right to occupy premises (Transfer Certificate of Title, tax declaration, or notarized lease contract)
Comprehensive General Liability Insurance (CGL
